title: Kadke Kamal Ke
desc: Two carefree men travel to Mumbai at the advice of a fortune teller and try to become rich without any effort. However, they encounter twists and turns during the course of their mission.

title: Aakhri Kasam
desc: A man loses his wife and son when an evil landowner attacks and kills them. Subsequently, he kidnaps one of the landowner's sons and grooms him to be a morally upstanding man.

title: Kaise Kaise Rishte
desc: A young man from a rich family helps a lonely child after an accident. However, things become complicated when he takes him home and develops a friendship.

title: Dear Maya
desc: Anna and Ira, two young women, begin a prank by sending letters to a local woman under the guise of a secret admirer. However, things take a turn for the worse when she goes missing.

title: Rahu Ketu
desc: Ravi, a CBI inspector, goes undercover to a remote town in order to investigate the rising suspicious deaths. However, things become complicated when he gets arrested by the local police.

title: Apaatkaal
desc: After witnessing the murder of her family, Shika vows revenge on the gang that murdered them. However, Sagar, her fiancé and a policeman, is unable to support her plans.
